name: Government Polytechnic College, Bikaner
affiliated_to: Board of Technical Education Rajasthan (BTER), Jodhpur
overview: Government Polytechnic College, Bikaner is a leading center of technical learning in Western Rajasthan, pioneering solar energy and desert civil engineering technologies alongside traditional engineering branches.
admission_process: Centralized admission via DTE Rajasthan portal on the basis of 10th percentage.
eligibility: Minimum 35% in 10th board with Science & Math.

fee_structure.fee_exemptions: Full tuition fee waiver for all female students.

hostel_facilities: Boys and Girls hostels with mess, desert air-cooling systems, indoor games.
campus_facilities: Solar energy demonstration park, testing labs, computer labs, library.
